# Lindani Farm

> Four private self-catering studios on a farm in Klein-Drakenstein, just outside Paarl in the Cape Winelands, South Africa. The studios interlink in pairs for families. Bookings are made on NightsBridge.

## Key facts
- Address: Lindani Plaas, Klein-Drakenstein, Paarl, Western Cape, South Africa
- Phone and WhatsApp: 063 678 2359 (+27636782359)
- Email: info@lindanifarm.co.za
- Book online: https://book.nightsbridge.com/40392
- Check-in from 14:00, check-out by 10:00. Self check-in.
- Minimum stay: 2 nights for stays that include a Friday or Saturday night.
- Self-catering; no pets.

## Studios
- Studio One: Queen bed, sleeps 2, from R1,400 per night. Opens into Studio Two to make a family unit for four.
- Studio Two: Queen bed, sleeps 2, from R1,400 per night. Opens into Studio One to make a family unit for four.
- Studio Three: Queen bed, sleeps 2, from R1,400 per night. Opens into Studio Four to make a family unit for four.
- Studio Four: Queen bed, sleeps 2, from R1,400 per night. Opens into Studio Three to make a family unit for four.

In every studio:
- Queen bed with quality linen and an electric blanket
- Kitchenette with stove, microwave, fridge, toaster and air fryer
- En-suite shower, towels and hairdryer
- Air-conditioning, a safe and cleaning service
- Free Wi-Fi, TV with Netflix and Prime Video
- Pool, braai area and secure parking

## Rates
- R1,400 per unit per night
- Festive season (1 December 2026 to 17 January 2027): R1,800 per unit per night
- Easter (25 March 2027 to 5 April 2027): R1,800 per unit per night
- 2027 rate (from 6 April 2027): R1,500 per unit per night

## Frequently asked questions
- How do I book? On NightsBridge, our booking calendar: tap any "Book" button on this site, choose your dates and units, and book instantly. Questions first? WhatsApp us on 063 678 2359.
- How do I pay? By EFT. Pay a 50% deposit within 24 hours of booking and the balance 7 days before check-in, or pay in full upfront. If your stay is less than 7 days away, full payment confirms it. Use your invoice number as the reference and send the proof of payment on WhatsApp or by email.
- What if I need to cancel? Cancellations must be in writing to info@lindanifarm.co.za. 30 days or more before arrival, nothing is forfeited; 21 days before, 25%; 14 days before, 50%; 7 days before, 100%. No-shows and early departures aren't refunded. Refunds are paid within 7–10 business days.
- Can I change my dates? Yes, up to 30 days before check-in, subject to availability. If the new dates have different rates, the difference is charged or refunded.
- What time is check-in and check-out? Check-in is from 14:00 to 17:00. Arriving later? Let us know in advance so we can arrange it (a fee may apply). Check-out is by 10:00. Early check-in and late check-out depend on bookings: ask us on the day.
- How does check-in work? It's self check-in. Once your stay is paid in full, we send your access code, parking details and directions on WhatsApp the day before you arrive. Park in the marked bays at the stone feature wall and walk down the stairs to the units.
- Is there a minimum stay? Two nights for stays that include a Friday or Saturday night. Shorter stays may be possible on other dates: just ask.
- Are meals included? Lindani is self-catering. Every unit has a kitchenette with a stove, microwave, fridge, toaster, air fryer, and tea and coffee, and there's a braai area with firewood provided.
- Can a family stay together? Yes. The units interlink in pairs (One with Two, Three with Four). Book both units of a pair and open the connecting door: a family of four gets two bedrooms, two bathrooms and two kitchenettes under one roof.
- Can we bring children? Yes. Each unit sleeps two (children pay the same rate as adults), and the units interlink in pairs to make a family unit for four. There's no lifeguard at the pool: children under 12 may not swim unaccompanied.
- Can we bring our dog? Sorry, pets aren't allowed. The farm has its own dogs, horses, geese and chickens.
- Can we swim in the dam? No, please don't swim in the dam, but you're welcome to walk down to the water. The pool is open from sunrise to sunset.
- Is there Wi-Fi and air-conditioning? Yes: free Wi-Fi, air-conditioning and a TV with Netflix and Prime Video in every unit, plus secure parking inside the farm gates.
- Can we book the whole farm? Yes. All four units together sleep eight, which suits families, friends and wedding guests. Parties and events in the units aren't allowed.

## Nearby
- Avondale (10 min): Organic wine estate with an eco-safari and Faber restaurant.
- Klein Parys Vineyards (13 min): Wine tasting and a relaxed estate on the edge of Paarl.
- Nederburg (14 min): One of the Cape's best-known wine estates, on the Paarl side of the valley.
- Vendôme (15 min): Historic wine estate and wedding venue on the Berg River.
- Laborie (15 min): A historic Paarl estate among the vines, with a restaurant, wedding venue and the Paarl Trails.
- Spice Route (20 min): Wine, craft beer, chocolate and good food on one hilltop estate.
- Rhebokskloof (25 min): Lakeside lawns and mountain views, one of the best-known wedding venues near Paarl.
- Paarl Main Street (14 min): Shops and restaurants along the town's oak-lined main road.
- Du Toitskloof Pass viewpoint (17 min): Big views back over the Paarl valley from the pass above the farm.
- Du Toitskloof hiking trails (20 min): Mountain trails from the Kromrivier and Elandsrivier trailheads.
- Paarl Rock and Paarl Mountain (20 min): The granite domes of the Paarl Mountain Nature Reserve, with walks through fynbos.
- Playrock Adventure Park (15 min): Outdoor adventure park for children on the Wemmershoek road.
- Drakenstein Lion Park (25 min): A sanctuary for rescued lions that can't return to the wild.
- Boschenmeer Golf Estate (15 min): Eighteen holes in Paarl with mountain views.
- Franschhoek (30 min): The valley of restaurants and wine farms, an easy drive over the hill.
- Akademia (Paarl campus) (13 min): A quiet base for parents visiting students in Paarl.
- La Rochelle Girls' High (14 min): Close enough for sports days, concerts and long weekends.
- Paarl Boys' High (14 min): Close enough for derby days, sports and school events.
- Boland College (16 min): An easy drive into Paarl.
- Green School South Africa (16 min): In the valley, near Paarl.
- Paarl Gymnasium (19 min): Across town in Paarl.
- Stellenbosch University (30 min): Half an hour away, for visits to students in Stellenbosch.
